<h2>Convert a v1 sjSDM Tier Regularization Selection</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Validates the frozen v1 tier-selection table and upgrades its embedded
schema marker without changing scientific content or creation provenance.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>convert_v1_sjsdm_tier_regularization_selection(data_selection = NULL)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_selection">data_selection</code></td>
<td>
<p>Frozen v1 tier-selection table.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Exact v2 tier-selection table.
</p>
